headline: Artan to referee Uefa Super Cup after losing World Cup role
context: Somali referee Omar Artan is appointed to take charge of the Uefa Super Cup match between Paris St-Germain and Aston Villa later this summer after being denied a spot at the World Cup.

sources.name: BBC
